intro: Stormwind Stockade holds the city’s most dangerous prisoners beneath the canals near the Mage Quarter. A coordinated revolt has driven the guards from the lower cells, leaving the prison in chaos.

p: Warden Thelwater oversees the Stockade, where Stormwind keeps cutthroats, Defias operatives, captured Blackrock orcs, and Dark Iron dwarves. Now a violent uprising led by the Defias conspirator Bazil Thredd has forced the guards from the lower cells. The prisoners roam freely through the corridors. Thelwater has managed to secure the entrance, but the revolt still threatens to reach the canals. He depends on adventurers to enter the prison and put down the uprising.
